messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: kv-cache continuous-batching error-rate spike detected in prod (us-west-2). Affected models: qwen-heavy, mistral-7b. 5xx increase + latency cliffs. Runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/kv-contbatch

alex_oncall: i'm on it. seeing a sharp rise in kv-miss ratio and continuous-batch queue depth. paging now. grabbing logs and metrics.

jen_sre: i'm awake, i can join. can you post the top error trace / tails? also what's the change window?

alex_oncall: past 30m deploy shows batching-controller config change. suspect `max_batch_tokens` bumped from 1024 -> 8192 on canary. logs:
```
[2026-03-15T10:03:12Z] ERROR kv-cache request timeout model=qwen-heavy shard=3 err=KVFetchTimeout
[2026-03-15T10:03:15Z] WARN batcher queue-depth=1200 max_batch_tokens=8192 inflight=350
[2026-03-15T10:04:01Z] ERROR kv-eviction thrash count=27
```

maria_eng: confirming: I promoted a config to canary at 09:55 for throughput testing. The intention was higher batching to boost throughput for low-concurrency workloads but didn't consider prefix cardinality. rolling back candidate now.

lee_ml: important model nuance: qwen-heavy has high prefix cardinality for our chat workloads (many distinct prefixes), so larger batch token window expands the prefetch window and blows up the KV working set. that increases evictions and causes more cold misses -> latency spikes (classic cache thrash).

tom_support: customer impact check: two customers reported errors to support: CUST-721 (video-summaries) and CUST-440 (search-assist). They see 500s and timeouts. No billing impact reported. raising status to "degraded" for external comms if not stabilized in 30m.

jen_sre: mitigation plan (short):
- rollback batching-controller config to sha=def456 (pre-change)
- reduce batch window to 20ms (was 200ms) via runtime flag `--batch-window-ms=20`
- enable aggressive kv eviction policy on affected shards: POST /admin/kv/evict?policy=aggressive
- route high-cardinality traffic to qwen-lite fallback for 30m via routing rules
- monitor 5xx and p95 latency

alex_oncall: executing rollback now: `deployctl rollback batching-controller --to=sha=def456 --env=prod`
output: `started rollback job id=rb-20260315-09`

ops_deploy: i've queued a deploy job to set `--batch-window-ms=20` and will flip the routing rule to send traffic matching prefix-cardinality>500 to qwen-lite. command: `trafficctl route add --match=prefix_cardinality>500 --to=qwen-lite --duration=30m`

jen_sre: also issuing kv admin command: `curl -X POST "https://kv-admin.prod/redwood/evict?policy=aggressive&shard=3,4,5" -H 'Authorization: Bearer **REDACTED**'`
response snippet:
```
{"status":"ok","evicted":12800,"shards":[3,4,5]}
```

alex_oncall: after rollback and routing tweak, error-rate dropped ~70% in the last 4 minutes. p95 latency for qwen-heavy dropped from 980ms -> 260ms. still watching. :white_check_mark:

tom_support: prepping customer comms: draft message ready to send if stabilized >20m. pinging CSMs for proactive outreach.

maria_eng: quick follow-up: the canary config included `prefetch_concurrency=64` as well; increase likely amplified the problem. we'll put a validation check on config values for models flagged as high-prefix-cardinality. adding to follow-ups.

lee_ml: recommend we add a model-profile check in the routing layer that blocks aggressive batching for models with high prefix cardinality. filing an RFC after incident.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-KV-THRASH. Severity: Sev2. Link: https://redwood/incidents/INC-2026-0315-KV-THRASH

jen_sre: action items so far:
- rollback completed (maria)
- batch window lowered (ops_deploy)
- aggressive eviction triggered (jen_sre)
- routing to qwen-lite active (ops_deploy)
- customer drafts prepared (tom_support)

alex_oncall: current metrics (last 5m):
- total 5xx: 42 -> 12
- kv-miss-rate: 0.62 -> 0.18
- batcher queue depth: 1200 -> 140
- p95 latency (qwen-heavy): 980ms -> 260ms

ops_deploy: monitoring dashboards show stabilization; I'll keep the routing rule for 30m then gradually relax.

tom_support: customers notified internally; holding external message pending full stabilization (will send templated update at +30m if ongoing).

jen_sre: planning handoff: i'll stay on for one more 30m window, then hand off to @ops_deploy for overnight monitoring. please include logs, commands executed, and a short TL;DR in the incident doc.

alex_oncall: TL;DR for doc: Canaries increased `max_batch_tokens` and `prefetch_concurrency` -> KV working set explosion for high-cardinality models (qwen-heavy) -> eviction thrash -> 5xx + latency. Hotfix: rollback config, reduce batch window, enable aggressive eviction, route traffic to qwen-lite. Next: validation gate for batching params + model-profile-based routing.

ops_deploy: taking handoff at 1759992100. leaving monitoring checks: uptimes, p95, kv-miss. marking thread for follow-up: add RFC for config validation and routing guard. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

incident-bot: Handoff completed to ops_deploy. Incident status: stabilizing.
